title: Count Numbers with Unique Digits
statement:
Given an integer `n`, return the count of all numbers with unique digits, `x`, where `0 <= x < 10^n`.
Use Digit DP with state tracking available digits bitmask.

examples.explanation: Numbers with unique digits from 0 to 99: all except 11, 22, 33, 44, 55, 66, 77, 88, 99.

n = int(input())
